title: Someone finds the event
sub: These are different entrances to the same event. A link never carries someone else’s identity or RSVP.
next: Open the event in the surface that actually works.

lanes.title: From an invitation
lanes.note: A normal invitation, an installed-app example, or an invitation with an optional event code.

lanes.title: From inside Astir
lanes.note: Tap an event in the new Events tab, or reopen Astir after an earlier RSVP.

title: Open the event. Keep the right state.
sub: Full app, App Clip, and browser are clearly separate. The same event and permission rules apply in each.
gate: Which surface opened? Then: is the account recognized, and is the RSVP confirmed?
next: Unknown identity → recover the account. Known with no RSVP → sign up. Already confirmed → skip ahead to the texts and guest controls.

lanes.title: FULL APP · installed and opens
lanes.note: Three alternative states: identity unknown / known with no RSVP / known and confirmed.
lanes.end: Existing confirmed guests skip registration. The Events tab also opens this event.

lanes.title: APP CLIP · no full app, Clip works
lanes.note: The event opens in App Clip. No full-app tabs.
lanes.end: Confirmed guests can see the guest list and manage their RSVP here.

lanes.title: BROWSER · Clip unavailable or link stays on web
lanes.note: Equivalent web event. A browser opening does not prove the app is absent.
lanes.end: Confirmed guests can see the guest list and manage their RSVP here.

lanes.title: Earlier review screens of these same entrances
lanes.note: These numbered screens remain in the review. They illustrate the event cover, browser fallback, in-app detail, and signed-out app state.

title: Sign in and complete only what is missing
sub: Unknown does not mean “no RSVP.” Establish the account and look up its booking before creating anything new.
gate: Existing reservation found? Restore its actual state. Otherwise complete identity and phone verification.
next: Only a successful registration result can confirm a place.

lanes.title: New guest · App Clip or browser
lanes.note: Apple or Google stays. Collect missing name and phone. Future-event texts are a separate, optional checkbox.
arrows: Account established; no existing RSVP
Send and verify SMS code
lanes.end: Verified identity → check code, capacity, and approval mode below.

lanes.title: In the installed app
arrows: Account found with no RSVP; only if phone verification is missing
Enter SMS verification code
Now the account and current phone are verified
lanes.end: Existing booking found → restore it. Already verified with no RSVP → skip both phone screens and go directly to Ready to RSVP.

lanes.title: Switch account or recover an existing RSVP
lanes.note: Each returns to the actual account/booking result in its original surface. Recovering does not automatically confirm anything.

lanes.title: Recognized and ready to RSVP
lanes.note: The phone is verified and no active RSVP exists. Submit the request, then apply the real registration result.

lanes.title: The lookup is still unresolved
lanes.note: Loading and failed are distinct states. Retry without inventing a missing or confirmed RSVP.

lanes.title: Sign-in or SMS fails
lanes.note: Cancel sign-in → return to sign-in. Wrong/expired SMS code → retry or change the number. Keep the event.

lanes.title: Only when optional invitation codes are enabled
lanes.note: Valid code → continue the account/RSVP flow. Invalid code → correct it in the same surface. This is separate from SMS verification.

title: Did the RSVP actually confirm?
sub: Free RSVP. Automatic confirmation is the default when eligible capacity is available; Astir can choose manual approval.
gate: Confirmed / pending approval / waitlisted / offered are different states.
next: Confirmed → continue below. Every other state waits for its own valid outcome.

lanes.title: YES · the place is confirmed
lanes.note: App Clip/web confirmation and the installed-app equivalent. Calendar is available; download is optional.
lanes.end: Guest list + View or change RSVP are now unlocked.

lanes.title: Manual approval is enabled
lanes.note: App Clip/web and full-app versions. A request is pending, not confirmed.
lanes.end: Astir approves → confirmed. Otherwise keep the real pending/declined state.

lanes.title: No available place yet
lanes.note: The guest is waiting. Released places are protected for Astir selections.
lanes.end: Astir selects this guest → send an offer. Never promote automatically.

lanes.title: Astir offers this guest a place
lanes.note: The selected guest must accept their current valid offer.
lanes.end: Accepted in time → confirmed. Default expiry is 24 hours; console can change it.

lanes.title: The offer expired before acceptance
lanes.note: Expired is not confirmed and does not produce a ticket.
lanes.end: Return to the waiting/event state.

title: Stay connected by text. No download required yet.
sub: The reservation is complete. Time passes here. Every “View event” link reopens this event using the guest’s current app and account state.
gate: Optional now: download Astir. Required later: full app for the entry QR.
next: When the guest chooses to prepare for entry, open or install Astir.

lanes.title: The text program
lanes.note: Texts continue without the app. Send applicable reminders only while the reservation and messaging eligibility remain valid. Skipping elapsed reminders for a late RSVP is a proposed operating detail.
arrows: Time passes · 24-hour reminder
Time passes · 2-hour reminder
lanes.end: Each View event link returns to the correct event state, not automatically to installation.

lanes.title: Important updates and event details
lanes.note: Important changes can trigger another text. A confirmed return opens App Clip/web detail or the installed-app detail.

lanes.title: Guest list and RSVP management
lanes.note: Both are unlocked by a recognized confirmed RSVP, including App Clip/web. They do not require download.

lanes.title: The guest chooses to cancel before start
lanes.note: Open cancellation from View or change RSVP.
arrows: Confirm cancellation
lanes.end: Release the place; guest-list/booking benefits end. Apply waitlist rules to released capacity.

lanes.title: Cancellation is closed
lanes.note: After the event starts, show the closed cancellation state. Preserve the actual reservation.

lanes.title: The event is rescheduled
lanes.note: If the guest keeps their place, the RSVP remains confirmed and timing follows the new schedule.
arrows: Guest chooses to cancel
Confirm cancellation
View the updated event without this reservation

lanes.title: The event itself is canceled
lanes.note: No active entry ticket. Inform guests and retire scheduled event reminders.

lanes.title: Find it again in Events
lanes.note: Confirmed events first when they exist. A separate empty state appears if there are no nearby events.

title: Later: open or install Astir for the QR
sub: Keep the same event, account, and RSVP. Skip the general product tour on this route.
gate: Full app + confirmed booking + valid name and username are required before any entry QR. Photo is optional.
next: Once the required account details are valid, the entry QR is ready.

lanes.title: No full app yet · guest chooses to prepare
arrows: Explain why the app is needed → App Store
Open Astir with the event context
Recover the same account and booking
lanes.end: Valid booking found → check the required name and username.

lanes.title: Required account details are missing
lanes.note: A photo is optional. No QR is shown until the required fields are valid.
arrows: Complete the missing name / username
lanes.end: Save valid details → the entry QR.

lanes.title: No RSVP found for this account
arrows: Sign in with the account used to RSVP
lanes.end: Look up the same event again. Do not create a second RSVP.

lanes.title: OPTION A · ticket first; photo below it
lanes.note: The first two are the original and comparison versions of option A. From either ticket, Add a photo opens optional photo setup.
lanes.end: Use photo or Skip → return to the ticket. This layout choice remains open.

lanes.title: OPTION B · optional photo before ticket
lanes.note: Required name and username are already valid. This is the alternative layout, not an extra required step.
arrows: Continue or Skip · photo stays optional

lanes.title: The optional photo fails
lanes.note: Retry the photo or keep going to the valid ticket. Failure does not remove entry access.

title: At the door: show the QR and record admission
sub: The guest uses Astir. Staff use the internal web console. Admission and the later personal event check-in are separate.
gate: Is this event’s confirmed ticket valid, and is Astir installed?
next: A successful admission record enables the attendee’s later post-event path. It does not create a personal post or place visit.

lanes.title: Normal arrival
arrows: Guest shows QR → staff scans in web console
Valid ticket → record admission
lanes.end: The event happens. Afterward, Astir publishes the recap when it is ready.

lanes.title: Installed guest cannot load their QR
arrows: Ask for help at the door
Staff takes over in the web console
Find and verify this event’s confirmed booking
lanes.end: Only a verified confirmed guest with Astir installed can receive manual admission.

lanes.title: Staff must not create another admission
lanes.note: Already admitted / invalid ticket / no eligible booking. These are distinct results.
lanes.end: Duplicate → do not add attendance. Invalid or no match → investigate; do not admit from this state.

lanes.title: The phone cannot run Astir
lanes.note: The agreed entry rule has no unsupported-phone or no-app bypass.

title: Offline door: prepare, admit, reconcile
sub: Team admins prepare this event’s list while online. During an outage, local entry remains pending server validation.
gate: Is a usable roster saved for this admin and event, and can the guest’s confirmed booking and installed account be established?
next: Only validated server admission contributes eligibility for the post-event check-in and protected recap. Offline publishing is not available.

lanes.title: Prepare, then use the downloaded guest list
lanes.note: A saved roster can miss recent changes. Local save failure must show Not recorded, never success.
arrows: Download succeeds; later the connection is lost
Checks pass and the local entry saves durably
lanes.end: Find the next guest while offline. Reopening retains the queue; recap access waits.

lanes.title: Connection returns: reconcile every entry
lanes.note: Resolved, duplicate, conflicting and retryable entries remain distinct. Team admins review conflicts without silently restoring canceled bookings.
arrows: Server returns a result for each entry
Open the changed-booking conflict
lanes.end: Retry waiting entries; preserve unresolved work. One canonical admission per guest/event.

lanes.title: A usable roster or local storage is unavailable
lanes.note: Missing list, wrong account/event, uncertain identity or unavailable storage provides no basis for an invented entry.
lanes.end: Reconnect or obtain an authorized prepared device. No bypass of guest app/account requirements.

title: After the event: bring them back when the recap is ready
sub: Publish the recap first. Then an in-app notice, text, and permitted push invite the guest back to the same event.
gate: Is the recap published? Is there valid admission for this event? Has this attendee completed the event check-in before?
next: Admitted + first completion → event check-in below. Admitted + previously completed → directly to the shared recap.

lanes.title: The recap is ready
lanes.note: SMS, the in-app notice, and Past events are different entrances. Each checks the current event/admission/completion state.
lanes.end: The user’s own state determines which branch opens.

lanes.title: Not published yet
lanes.note: Full-app pending content, the ended event detail, and the no-app version. Stay on this event and return when ready.

lanes.title: No recorded admission
lanes.note: Show the allowed event preview. Comments are unreadable; the shared gallery stays locked. If an attendee’s scan was missed, ask staff to verify and correct it.

lanes.title: The guest deleted the app
lanes.note: Event viewing remains available. Restored admission and historical completion decide the next screen.
arrows: Choose the app-only check-in or upload action
Reinstall and recover the same attendee account
lanes.end: Unresolved identity/admission/completion → loading or retry. No valid admission → preview or staff help. Valid admission: never completed → event check-in; already completed → shared recap.

lanes.title: An unlocked recap temporarily fails to load
lanes.note: Retry loading. Do not erase the recorded completion or force a second check-in.

title: Make the event check-in. Unlock the shared recap.
sub: One explicit event check-in creates an event-led personal post and one canonical Been visit at the place. Every composer field is optional.
gate: First completion creates one visit. Historical completion prevents a second forced check-in.
next: The event memory leads naturally into the ordinary map and place profile.

lanes.title: First admitted return
lanes.note: Optional note, own photos, event tags, and private feedback. No public venue rating is collected or created.
arrows: Submit the event check-in; even with optional fields empty
Optionally choose photos from the shared gallery
Add selected photos to this same personal post
lanes.end: The recap remains available after completion; adding gallery photos is optional.

lanes.title: Join the conversation
lanes.note: From the shared recap. Ordinary replies and likes.
arrows: Post the comment / reply
lanes.end: Return to the shared recap.

lanes.title: Contribute photos or videos
lanes.note: Full-app action. The uploader or Astir can remove the source media.
arrows: Upload succeeds → visible to eligible viewers
Open management for your own upload

lanes.title: Upload fails or someone opens a video
lanes.note: Upload failure → preserve the draft and retry or omit. Video opens from the protected recap gallery.

lanes.title: Delete the personal event post
lanes.note: Manage → confirm deletion → post and its event visit are removed. The resulting recap and place screens show the independent effects.
lanes.end: Historical completion, valid recap entitlement, and unrelated place visits remain.

lanes.title: A source gallery photo is removed
lanes.note: These are the affected personal post, recap, and remaining gallery. Remove references to that source photo; retain other content and the place visit.

title: Continue into Astir’s map and the place
sub: Every event has one canonical place. A place can have many events. The event check-in still counts as a check-in at that place.
gate: Apply event visibility and the viewer’s recap rights independently.
next: This completes the guest journey. Home-location controls and operator flows below support it in parallel.

lanes.title: Attendee explores the event on the map
lanes.note: The expanded event is the same event/recap already shown above. The place has inline Events here.
arrows: Tap the special pin → collapsed card over the map
Expand event → use its place link → standard place profile
lanes.end: No separate recommendations detour.

lanes.title: A nonattendee sees the same permitted event
arrows: Tap the pin → collapsed card
Expand the allowed event preview → open the linked place
lanes.end: The recap stays locked without valid admission and completion.

lanes.title: Ordinary discovery and optional permissions
lanes.note: Ordinary map/search stays usable. Location is requested when choosing nearby; notification permission when choosing event alerts. These do not interrupt the entry or recap path.

title: Parallel rule: when the event is at a home
sub: These location states apply wherever that event or place appears. They are not extra steps after the map.
gate: Resident consent + confirmed guest + current reveal window?
next: Approximate location remains outside the permitted exact-address window. Recap access is a separate permission.

lanes.title: Visitor or no address entitlement
lanes.note: Show the allowed event and place with an approximate area, not an exact pin.

lanes.title: Confirmed, before reveal
lanes.note: Show the reveal time and approximate area. Default reveal: 24 hours before event start.

lanes.title: Confirmed, within the reveal window
lanes.note: Exact details become available. A late confirmation within the window gets access immediately.

lanes.title: After address access expires
lanes.note: Return to approximate location. Default expiry: 24 hours after event end; console can change it. Independent location rights remain separate.

title: Parallel actor: Astir’s internal web console
sub: These are staff/operator paths that support the journey above. Guests never walk through them.
gate: Only an authorized operator can publish, approve, correct admission, or change these controls.
next: End of the full screen map.

lanes.title: Create the event
arrows: Preview the draft
Publish succeeds
lanes.end: The invitation is ready to share.

lanes.title: Choose the event’s operating rules
lanes.note: Independent settings: approval, offers, map promotion, home privacy, messages, check-in tags, invitation codes, notifications.

lanes.title: Approve a pending request
arrows: Open a pending request
Approve successfully
lanes.end: Guest becomes confirmed and receives the appropriate confirmation.

lanes.title: Offer a waiting guest a place
arrows: Astir selects the guest and sends the offer
lanes.end: Guest must accept before expiry. Sending is not confirmation.

lanes.title: Publish the recap before inviting
arrows: Publish succeeds → queue invitations
lanes.end: Notice and texts lead into the post-event return decision.

lanes.title: Publication or invitation fails
lanes.note: Failed publication → no recap invitation. Published with failed invitations → retry failures without double-sending successful deliveries.

lanes.title: Correct a missed admission
arrows: Staff verifies attendance and saves the correction
lanes.end: Admission is restored. A first event check-in is still required.

lanes.title: Remove a shared source upload
arrows: Astir removes the source photo
lanes.end: Remove its references; keep the rest of the event and personal-post content.
